name: library-survey-pwa
description: Offline-first Library Survey PWA wrapped with Capacitor

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:native && npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run build:native && npm run prepare:web && npx cap add ios
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build:native && npm run prepare:web && npx cap add android
